newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 17.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 17.

text.p: The following were the noon headlines on Latvian state radio. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Prime Minister Andris Shkele said the government's resignation was possible as he returned from holidays in Britain, citing ministers' resignations and a scandal over state company loans.
- Political parties differ over the likelihood of the government's collapse.
- A Russian and Latvian transport commission is meeting in Moscow. It will discuss an air transport agreement and aviation company debts.
